title: Reedy Rides

services.name: eBike
services.desc: Perfect for tourists, new residents or people looking to become more familiar with the trail. Get an informational and guided tour of the Swamp Rabbit Trail including trail history and all the newest cool additions. An exciting 2 hour tour through Greenville’s bustling downtown and beautiful parks, with waterfall views. Then, a leisurely ride north to the Swamp Rabbit Cafe for some delicious stecca bread, a favorite of both locals and visitors! Points of interest you’ll see on this tour: Falls Park, Cancer Survivors Park, Cleveland Park, Unity Park, and the Swamp Rabbit Cafe and Grocery. Enjoy all that Greenville has to offer and then head north 7 miles to the campus of Furman University.

Come explore downtown Greenville and the Swamp Rabbit Trail. From parks to shops and restaurants, biking is the fastest, most fun and greenest way to explore
